title: List toolbar: Filter, Sort and Display as icon buttons with count badges, one shape on every list
body:
## Source

Read on objectui main `8415d9f11` at 1024 and 1280 px, on HotCRM lists and on Setup lists (Approval Requests, Audit Logs): the toolbar's tool cluster draws Filter, Sort and Display as ghost buttons with icon + label; the Display trigger in `packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` hides its label only below the `sm` breakpoint (640 px), and Filter / Sort follow the same shape. At 1024 px the cluster takes about 260 px beside the view tabs, which is where the view strip starts folding into "N more" (the fold is width-driven, objectui#12440) and where Studio's chips truncate (objectui#12611). The Setup page-shell card (objectui#12606) first proposed hiding Display on Setup lists behind a view-count gate; on 2026-10-16 the maintainer dropped that gate in favour of one smaller shape for every list, verbatim: 「可以」, agreeing to the PM's proposal that Filter, Sort and Display shrink to icons together rather than Display alone.

## Target

1. Filter, Sort and Display render as 28 px icon buttons (funnel, arrows, sliders) with `aria-label` and `title` as today and no visible label at any width; the count badge stays beside the icon (Filter 2 · Sort 1 · Display 2) and is the only text in the cluster. The search icon and the `+` are unchanged.
2. One shape on every list that mounts the toolbar: app object lists, Setup `sys_*` lists, related lists. No per-surface variant and no view-count gate anywhere.
3. Accessible names unchanged: `getByRole('button', { name: 'Display' })`, `{ name: 'Filter' }`, `{ name: 'Sort' }` still resolve; the popovers themselves are unchanged.
4. Fallback the lane may take only with a reason in the PR: keep labels at ≥ 1280 px by moving the existing breakpoint from `sm` to `xl` on the same three buttons. The card lands icon-only by default.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (the Display trigger), the Filter and Sort triggers the list toolbar mounts beside it in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` and their components, tests beside; i18n keys unchanged (the labels still serve `aria-label` / `title`).

## Acceptance

1. Tests: the three triggers render no visible label text and keep their accessible names; the count badges render.
2. Screenshots of a HotCRM list and of Setup › Approval Requests at 1024 and 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list test`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- objectui#12621 (the Display menu closes after a layout choice) touches the same popover file; whichever lands second rebases.
- The cluster already carries `data-print-hide`; printing is unchanged.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (never merged): [setup-approval-requests.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-approval-requests.png?raw=true) (commit `01244b886`, the cluster at 1280 px) · [hotcrm-display-menu.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-display-menu.jpg?raw=true) (commit `b72c97985`, what Display holds).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-16 from the maintainer's question on objectui#12606 about the Display control, after reading the fold rule and the popover's contents on objectui main `8415d9f11`.</sub>
